content.storyline: The 5-5 Patriots enter eighth in the AFC, outside the seven-team playoff field. New England will start Tommy DeVito, with Drake Maye expected to miss the remainder of the season.
matchup_notes: New England is 5-5 and second in the AFC East.
The Patriots’ most recent game was a 35-10 loss to Detroit; they had a Week 11 bye.
The Chargers lost 27-24 to the Jets in Week 11; the Week 12 matchup listing shows Los Angeles at 1-9.
The Patriots confirmed Tommy DeVito as their starter for Week 12, while Drake Maye is expected to miss the rest of the season with a fibula injury.
